title: Section 225.37 – Add a new Informational Note at the end of Section 225.37 to read as follows:
officialText:
Informational Note: Where additional approved disconnects are installed in accordance with 225.34, a permanent
plaque or directory installed at the entrances of both disconnect locations may be required.
